hero.badge: Free · Open source · Your data stays yours
hero.subtitle: DiabExplorer connects to your Nightscout server and turns your glucose data into interactive charts, clear statistics and reports ready for your care team.
hero.trust: Set up in 30 seconds · No account needed · Demo available
hero.chartAria: Simulated 24-hour glucose curve with target range between 70 and 180 mg/dL

how.title: Three steps, zero friction
how.subtitle: From your Nightscout server to your reports, everything connects in minutes.

steps.title: Connect your Nightscout
steps.description: Enter your Nightscout server URL and token. Your data stays in your browser: no account to create, nothing to install.

steps.title: Visualize your charts
steps.description: Real-time curves, trends, statistics and Time in Range over 14 days, with interactive charts and colored target zones.

steps.title: Share to MyDiabby
steps.description: Send your glucose readings to MyDiabby in one click to feed your logbook and prepare your appointments.

features.title: Everything to track, understand and act
features.subtitle: A complete dashboard, built with the diabetes community (#WeAreNotWaiting).

items.title: Real time
items.description: Your CGM readings appear as soon as they reach your Nightscout server.

items.title: Trends & alerts
items.description: Trend arrows and colored zones to spot glucose variations quickly.

items.title: Time in Range
items.description: Track your time in range, average, standard deviation and coefficient of variation.

items.title: Detailed statistics
items.description: Averages, min/max, insulin, carbs: everything is computed automatically for the selected period.

items.title: PDF & Glooko export
items.description: Generate a professional PDF report for your appointments, or export your data in Glooko format.

items.title: mg/dL ↔ mmol/L units
items.description: Switch instantly between both units, according to your habits or your team's.

forWhom.title: Built for every step of the diabetes journey
forWhom.subtitle: One clear view, useful to everyone: the person living with diabetes, their loved ones and their caregivers.

cards.title: People with diabetes
cards.description: Understand the impact of your meals, activities and treatments day to day, without spending hours on it.
bullets: No data sent to our servers

cards.title: Parents & loved ones
cards.description: Keep a calm eye on your child's data and share clear summaries with the care team.

cards.title: Caregivers
cards.description: Find the essentials about a patient at a glance: Time in Range, trends and exportable history.

cta.title: Ready to see your data differently?
cta.subtitle: Connect your Nightscout and get your first clear view in under a minute.

footer.tagline: DiabExplorer, open source Nightscout glucose data viewer, built for the diabetes community.
footer.disclaimer: Data visualization aid. Not a substitute for medical advice: when in doubt about your health, consult a professional.
footer.madeWith: Made with care for the #WeAreNotWaiting community
